thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: billing.metrics.token_delta (prod-eu) spike detected. token_count delta >8% vs baseline for 03:42-03:48 UTC. ~120 customers flagged for potential overage. link: https://ops.redwood.example/incidents/1717456789

sam: ack, I'm on it. grabbing logs + repro now.

jess: oncall? I can join triage if needed.

marco: I see a backlog on emitter-eu (kafka consumer lag ~15k). possible delayed emits causing replayed tokens.

sam: copying relevant logs below:
```
emitter:europe-1 - flushed 1.2M tokens at 03:47:02
kafka-offsets: topic=usage-window partition=12 offset_start=4578921 offset_end=4591105
billing-processor - windowing: processed_window_id=2026-03-18T03:42 shard=eu-03 latency_ms=3200
```

kirti: billing-bot reports lots of late-window ingests marked as "delayed" and a retry surge. showing overage-emails queue spike (100/min).

billing-bot: auto-flag:customer_overage_emails enqueued=98 rate=1.6/s backlog=420

sam: hypothesis: emitter consumer lag + emitter retry policy caused double-counting for some windows when replayed messages were reprocessed.

jess: can we suppress outgoing overage emails while we triage? we should avoid spamming customers.

marco: yes - suggest toggling notification-suppression in billing-config to true for eu region. I can flip it if ops approves.

oncall: flipping suppression now (billing-config.suppress_overage_notifications = true). will take ~30s to propagate.

incident-bot: action taken: billing-config updated by oncall. notification suppression enabled.

kirti: huge help. also recommend issuing temporary crediting for impacted customers before final reconciliation. billing team, confirm?

billing-bot: creating a provisional credit batch id=pc-1717456789 with note="auto credit due to ingest replay - pending audit"

billing-bot: pc-1717456789 queued (estimate credits for ~85 customers).

sam: mitigation checklist: 1) suppress notifications (done) 2) throttle emitter retries to 1/min 3) rewind consumer to safe offset and replay idempotently 4) run recount job for windows 03:40-03:50 UTC

marco: throttling emitter retries now (emitter.retry.backoff -> 60s).

sam: I'm going to run recount job — kicking off recount-eu job now. log: recount-job/1717456789 started.

jess: I'll open a short CS note draft: "We're investigating an unusual billing spike in EU region; notifications temporarily paused; credits being applied proactively. Expect update in 2 hours."

kirti: note for postmortem: check kafka producer acks and emitter dedupe headers. suspect recent change in emitter-client v2.7 that altered idempotency keys.

sam: recount job progress:
```
recount-eu: scanned windows 03:40-03:50 total_events=1,220,345 deduped=14,512 adjusted_tokens=-10,243
recount-eu: completed in 78s, proposed_adjustments=-10,243 tokens (~$12.45 total)
```

sam: preliminary result shows net overcount of ~10k tokens (small $ impact) vs earlier alert. looks like delayed replays inflated intermediate counters but final tally corrects most.

marco: great. still want billing squad to reconcile queued provisional credits; adjust amounts if recount shows smaller delta.

billing-bot: provisional credits updated: pc-1717456789 adjusted_amount=$9.80 (was estimated $14.50). awaiting manual review.

jess: I posted the CS note draft in #customer-comm-drafts. can someone from billing approve wording?

kirti: billing approve. wording fine, remove the line about "expect update in 2 hours" and instead say "we will follow up once reconciliation completes".

oncall: handoff: I'm leaving at 04:00 UTC. marco, can you take overnight oncall for billing-recon until morning rotation?

marco: taking handoff. will monitor reconciliation and un-suppress notifications only after credits finalized.

sam: closing active triage — key actions done: suppression, throttle, recount, provisional credits queued. follow-ups: deconflict emitter idempotency in next-day RCA, finalize credits, and customer comms.

incident-bot: incident resolved (status: mitigated). follow-up label: billing-metric-drift, severity: low-medium, assignees: billing-squad, emitter-team.

marco: tagging postmortem runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.example/postmortems/1717456789

jess: thanks team. I'll schedule a 30-min RCA sync for 09:30 UTC tomorrow. :thumbsup:

sam: noted. leaving notes in incident doc. ping if anything changes.
